    The national ELF list, from the cache

    nationalELFs.Rd

    buildELFs() through Cache(): built once and shared through the cloud cache. Its key is ELFversion alone: no argument, no code and no other parameter is part of it. Change ELFversion to rebuild. init and the ELFmaps event both read it, so the event gets the ELFs before the merges from the cache.

    nationalELFs(Par, inputPath)

    Arguments

    Par

    The module's parameters (P(sim)).

    inputPath

    Where downloads go (inputPath(sim)).

    Value

    As buildELFs().
